Still hanging with no output at all — which means even the first seed didn't print. So the hang is in the parent process, not the child? But the child has timeout=25 → subprocess.run raises TimeoutExpired after 25s → caught → prints... Hmm, but nothing printed at all.

Wait — output buffering! Python's stdout is block-buffered when not a tty. The prints are buffered and lost when the process is killed by timeout. That's why nothing appeared.

Let me add flush=True or run with -u.
